Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) said, "When an Aalim forsakes the statement 'I do not know', then he has reached his point of destruction." Another narration also states that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) said, "When an Aalim omits using the statement 'I do not know', then he has reached his point of destruction." [^2]
The Conduct of Hadhrat Umar (RA), Hadhrat Ali (RA) and Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) when Teaching
Hadhrat Makhool reports that when Hadhrat Umar (RA) noticed that the people were getting tired as he narrated Ahadeeth to them, he would occupy them with planting trees. [^3]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mus'ab narrates that Hadhrat Umar bin Khattaab (RA) said, "Do not pay more than forty Awqiya as dowry, even though the bride may be the daughter of Dhul Udda Qais bin Husayn Haarithi. If anyone pays more, I shall deposit the surplus into the state treasury." A tall woman with a flat nose then stood up from the women's row saying, "You do not have the authority to do that." "Why not?" asked Hadhrat Umar (RA). She replied, "Because Allaah declares:

blocks.arabic_text: وَّاٰتَيْتُمْ اِحْدٰىهُنَّ قِنْطَارًا فَلَا تَاْخُذُوْا مِنْهُ شَيْئًا
blocks.text: ...when you have given one of them a fortune, then do not take anything from it ...'
To this, Hadhrat Umar (RA) remarked, "The lady is right and the man is wrong." [^4]

Hadhrat Muhammad bin Ka'b Qurazi (RA) narrates that a man once posed a question to Hadhrat Ali (RA), to which he gave a reply. "O Ameerul Mu'mineen!" the man said, "That is not the answer." He then proceeded to give the correct answer, to which Hadhrat Ali (RA) conceded, "You are right and I was wrong." He then recited the verse:
Above every knowledgeable person is one who is more knowledgeable. [^5]
